𝗗𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡 𝗬𝗨 𝗜𝗡 𝗠𝗠𝗙𝗙 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱 🎥

Our very own @dustinyuu is officially one of the lead actors in "Shake, Rattle, and Roll: Evil Origins" under Regal Entertainment Inc — an official entry to this year’s Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF)! 

From stepping into our hearts during his reality show journey, to now making his mark in Philippine cinema, Dustin continues to prove that 𝘩𝘦’𝘴 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘯 𝘫𝘶𝘴𝘵 𝘢 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘳 — 𝘩𝘦’𝘴 𝘢 𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘤𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘣𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘤𝘬𝘰𝘯𝘦𝘥 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩. His talent, dedication, and growth are something we, his solid supporters, will always be proud of. This is a huge milestone and an even brighter future ahead for him.🌟

Let’s rally behind him with all our love and support as he takes on the big screen with a role that will surely leave a lasting impact.

Congratulations, Dustin! You deserve all the recognition coming your way, we're very proud of you — always! 👏💚

#DustinYu 
#MMFF2025
